hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
echo 'Running Endpoint Health Verification...'
# Fetch the status code STATUS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/sample-java-app/)
if [ "$STATUS_CODE" -eq 200 ]; then echo "Deployment validation successful! HTTP Status: $STATUS_CODE" exit 0 else echo "Deployment validation failed with status code: $STATUS_CODE" echo "------------------ SERVER RESPONSE ------------------" # This prints the actual HTML error page from Tomcat so we can see the exact root cause curl -s http://localhost:8080/sample-java-app/ echo "-----------------------------------------------------" exit 1 fi
